description: Address code review findings: fix contrast issues on mega-turno badge and avisos button, eliminate duplicate nav declarations, and replace hardcoded hex colors with CSS variables in avisos-card and bienvenida inline styles.
steps: STEP 1 - Fix #78350f contrast issues in mega-turno badge (styles.css) and avisos button + burbuja-farmacia (index.html inline styles) by changing to #451a03
STEP 2 - Fix duplicate nav declarations by adding a comment to the early nav block indicating it is overridden later
STEP 3 - Replace hardcoded #0f766e/#0d9488 in avisos-card inline style with var(--primario)/var(--primario-medio)
STEP 4 - Replace hardcoded colors in bienvenida inline style with CSS variables where feasible
acceptance_criteria: Mega-turno badge text color is #451a03 for WCAG AA compliance
Avisos button text color is #451a03 for WCAG AA compliance
Early nav block has a comment indicating the override
Avisos-card uses var(--primario) and var(--primario-medio) instead of hardcoded hex
findings: All 5 review issues addressed: (1) mega-turno badge color changed to #451a03 for 7:1+ contrast ratio on amber gradient, (2) avisos button text same fix, (3) burbuja-farmacia text same fix, (4) duplicate nav visual properties removed from early block leaving only structural props, (5) avisos-card and bienvenida inline style now use var(--primario)/var(--primario-medio). The page-header-farmacia gradient still uses #78350f legitimately as a background color, not as text on amber.
